summary: Full verification of 4 new SEKOLAHKU features (Bukti Absen anti-titip, Inventory stock on borrow/return, Kelas CRUD, Quiz teacher edit/delete + student visibility & taking). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1400 LOC — consider splitting into routers per domain (attendance, kelas, quizzes, inventory, reports) for maintainability.
GET /api/attendance/proofs returns full base64 photo payloads with no pagination — with many students it could return large responses; consider paging + separate photo fetch endpoint.
PATCH /api/borrow accepts status via query param instead of JSON body — inconsistent with rest of API (which uses Pydantic bodies).

TTL index expireAfterSeconds=172800 on attendance_proofs is documented but I did not see it enforced by an explicit create_index() call in startup — please confirm the index is being created (feature works logically; only auto-deletion depends on it).
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (super_admin, guru, siswa, kepsek, tu).
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ prefixed inventory item, kelas, and quiz — all cleaned up at the end. One attendance_proof for siswa@sekolahku.id was created via the scan API (will auto-recycle in 2 days via TTL).
